A bright night ahead, good news
The subject is greeting routines
Travelers, please read this notice so your companion animal check-in stays smooth and calm.

Our Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is here to help with everyday travel steps in a warm, professional way. If you are bringing a pet, we will guide you with clear, practical advice and share the same notes with crew teams so everyone is working from the same plan. That helps keep the process simple for you and steady for your animal.

Please bring any usual travel papers and be ready to follow the guidance given at the desk. If your pet needs special handling, let us know early so we can keep the handoff clear and kind. Travelers such as Rina Hassan and Amara Davis have found that a little preparation makes the whole day easier, and pets like Cookie settle better when the routine feels familiar.

For help with companion animal travel, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
